title: Green Project
paragraphs: Involve Green is an eco endeavour by Involve to promote nature friendly living. It is a green initiative that encourages the society to embrace nature by promoting the origination and maintenance of vegetations such as Trees, Green Spaces, Tiny Forests, Big Forests and Agricultural Farms. This Project will appreciate the people who contribute to our nature and inspire others to do the same by creating and maintaining different types of Green Life in their surroundings.
closing: Read about our larger dream on the [Involve Forest](forest.html) page.
Want to know more about the Green Project? Write to {{email}} or use the details on our [contact section](index.html#contact).
